Okay, time for another cringy tweet about a very important issue in the contemporary—#BlackLivesMatter  vs #AllLivesMatter.

I took time out of my (VERY BUSY) Netflix-and-chill day to see what this #BlackLivesMatter uproar was truly about. This is what I found.

Today, I further researched the phrase #AllLivesMatter and found an article by Vox with the primary argument being that #BlackLivesMatter actually meant Black lives matter too, which is a sentiment I agree with.  They, however, stated that Black people are more likely to be shot.

Their data won the 2016 Pulitzer and struck me as a reputable source.  It showed that Black Americans WERE NOT dying more than Whites from police shootings with 497 White and 259 Black shootings in 2015—reaffirming my original stance regarding #BlackLivesMatter.

In conclusion, although #BlackLivesMatter is an influential movement (with the creation of shows such as Black Lightning, the continual media coverage, and the emphasis of Hip Hop Artists), it is a nonessential one.

@thehauscouch I support DACA, gay rights, and (hopefully 😇), everyone.  I'm a minority as well (Asian), but I say #AllLivesMatter because I think that the divisive undertones of #BlackLivesMatter falsely portray the police and whites as malicious figures while they are simply human.

@thehauscouch As an upcoming senior in high school... with my PLETHORA of life experience😂, I THINK that I think the #BlackLivesMatter movement is detrimental to society.  I did research on it and all it seems to do is hurt the police force here in America.

@thatssojayah @Eclipse_74 @toblarone77 @IntroToRacismIn Not #BlackLivesMatter which unreasonably insinuates that the police specifically target and kill Blacks for no reason.  It also implies that Whites are the ones doing the killing, therefore leading some to believe that most whites are abusive of their prosperity...

@thehauscouch Okay... I guess I've changed my mind about the #BLM movement.  I still think that the movement is flawed as it attacks the police, but something has to be done about the shootings of people like Antwon Rose.

Antwon Rose did not need to die unnecessarily in the recent police shooting.  So, if you support #BlackLivesMatter, good for you.  Black lives do matter, and All Lives Matter as well.  Let's focus on ending hatred and worry about the technicalities later.
